results.criterion: The site is one HTML file with inline or CDN-linked CSS and JavaScript, needs no build step, and contains no backend calls.
results.note: Mechanical check: 1 file, 40430 bytes, 0 external resources, 1 script, no JS errors. The only outbound actions are a user-initiated wa.me window and a mailto: link.

results.criterion: A booking section contains a request form whose submit opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message or email addressed to the clinic, and the section states that the clinic will confirm the appointment by phone.
results.note: The submit handler builds a wa.me/?text= or mailto:?subject&body link from the form fields, and #book shows book_notice 'the clinic will confirm your appointment by phone'. CLINIC_WHATSAPP and CLINIC_EMAIL are empty strings, so the message is not yet addressed to the clinic. This is the open input and the fine print tells the patient to choose a recipient.

results.criterion: A services section lists each service with a 'starting from' price range and a line stating that the final cost is confirmed after examination.
results.note: 8 .svc cards each show 'Starting from' plus a marked price placeholder, and svc_note says 'final cost is confirmed after examination'.

results.criterion: A dentist profiles section shows at least one profile, and every detail not supplied is a visibly marked placeholder.
results.note: #dentists 'Our dentists' has 1 card. Name, qualifications, specialty, experience, about and photo are all .ph placeholders.

results.criterion: An emergency dental contact is visible on the page, and the phone number and hours, if not supplied, are visibly marked placeholders.
results.note: #emergency is a non-collapsed card near the top of main, with .ph placeholders for the number and hours.

results.criterion: A patient FAQ section is present with at least one question and answer.
results.note: #faq contains 6 question and answer cards (q1-q6, a1-a6).

results.criterion: A language toggle switches every section, including the booking form, services, dentist profiles, emergency contact and FAQs, between English and Marathi, and the Marathi view shows a 'pending native review' label.
results.note: applyLang rewrites every [data-i18n] node, including form labels and options. Every key used in the HTML exists in both en and mr, and the review_banner Marathi value includes '(pending native review)' and is unhidden when lang is mr. The mechanical check shows no JS errors.

results.criterion: Every price, phone number, WhatsApp number, email address, dentist detail and emergency hour not yet supplied appears as a visibly marked placeholder in both languages.
results.note: Prices, WhatsApp, email, clinic phone, emergency number and hours, dentist fields, photo and address all use .ph spans, each with an English and a Marathi '[प्लेसहोल्डर: ...]' value. No invented numbers or prices found.

extra_issues.criterion: Standards: facts only the clinic holds must not be presented as real
extra_issues.note: FAQ a4, a5 and emergency_p2 give clinical advice (store a knocked-out tooth in milk, go to hospital for breathing trouble) in both languages. The clinic did not supply it and no clinician has reviewed it, yet it appears under the clinic's name. It is not tracked in open_inputs.
